candidate_program.name: bounded_turnaround_efficiency
candidate_program.rationale: Applies a bounded, continuous turnaround penalty to reward per active conflict. It uses only native root and neighborhood inputs; summed gaps approximate occupancy but cannot identify the resources shared with individual rivals.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 - 0.15 * degree / (1 + degree) * (station_gap + satellite_gap) / (1 + duration + station_gap + satellite_gap))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
